title: Metal shavings in pasta
text: Metal shavings in pasta. This doesn't fit my Kitchen Aid as well as it should.  Also, I haven't been able to get the metal shavings from mixing in with the pasta.  I ran several batches through and it's still there. This is very disappointing. I had hoped this would work.  I will be returning it.
